findings.title: Oracle 2025 Health Breach Compromised Data of 20 Million People - Bloomberg
findings.summary_md: Bloomberg reported on October 5, 2026 that a 2025 cyberattack on Oracle Health's legacy Cerner systems compromised personal and medical information of nearly 20 million people, citing a Texas attorney general filing. The figure exceeds earlier breach disclosures. Oracle declined to comment to Bloomberg.

findings.title: Oracle Health Breach Was Reported to Texas at Nearly 20 Million People - Texas Lawyer Referral Service
findings.summary_md: A Texas filing puts the 2025 Oracle Health legacy Cerner breach at nearly 20 million people, with about 3 million Texas residents affected, according to a report published October 7, 2026. Unauthorized access began on or about January 22, 2025 and was identified around February 20, 2025. The filing notes notification was delayed at federal law enforcement request.
